description: Provider-neutral synchronization binding. Tracked manifests contain semantic identity and a protected locator handle only; raw provider URLs, IDs, credentials, and user-specific filesystem paths are runtime-private.
provider_rules: adapter_id names the provider adapter, not an account or file.
locator_handle is a semantic private-resolution key and must not contain a provider URL, raw provider identifier, credential, or user-specific path.
locator_resolution must be private_runtime_only in tracked public manifests.
Exact provider identity is resolved at runtime from protected state; title or filename search is not an identity mechanism.
local_materialization_rules: ephemeral is the default for provider-backed artifacts.
ephemeral materialization uses an OS/runtime scratch location rather than the consumer repository.
successful provider write plus read-back verification permits cleanup of ephemeral bytes.
persistent mode requires explicit consumer policy and a bounded max_retained_bytes value.
a provider-backed edit must not silently degrade to local-only output merely because local file generation is easier.
sync_rules: Provider authority requires a provider freshness check before consuming a cached/materialized artifact.
A push requires a pre-write provider revision check and post-write read-back verification.
If both authoritative sides changed since the last common receipt, state is BLOCKED_CONFLICT.
Provider-native document formats must be mutated with the provider-native API; raw file replacement is only valid for blob files.
Periodic synchronization supplements checkpoint synchronization; it does not replace before-use and before-write freshness gates.
privacy_rules: Public Git may contain semantic locator handles but not raw private provider locators.
Private locator maps and OAuth material stay outside Git.
Tracked examples must use synthetic bindings only.
Sanitized tracked receipts must omit raw provider locators and private account identity.
